title: Ukrainian Parliament Formally Dismisses PM Svyrydenko
detail: The Verkhovna Rada voted to accept Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko's resignation, formally dismissing her government and clearing the way for Zelensky's cabinet reshuffle. Svyrydenko had served since July 2025 and previously negotiated the US-Ukraine critical minerals partnership. Zelensky nominated Naftogaz CEO Serhii Koretskyi as her replacement the following day.

media.caption: Ukraine's parliament votes to dismiss PM Svyrydenko, July 14, 2026

title: EU Opens Sixth Accession Negotiating Cluster With Ukraine
detail: The EU formally opened Cluster 6 (External Relations, including Chapters 30 and 31 on foreign, security, and defence policy) in Ukraine's accession negotiations at an intergovernmental conference in Brussels, alongside Moldova. The milestone followed new Hungarian PM Péter Magyar's government dropping the two-year veto over the process previously held by Viktor Orbán. Cluster 1 (Fundamentals) had opened in June 2026.
